title: Dukkaram
text: 3 Kiṃ nu āvuso Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajjā kho āvuso imasmim dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || 4 Pabbajitena panāvuso kim dukkaranti || || Pabbajitena kho āvuso abhirati dukkarāti || || 5 Abhiratena panāvuso kiṃ dukkaranti || || Abhiratena kho āvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipatti dukkarāti || || 6 Kiṃ va ciram panāvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhu arahaṃ assāti || || Na ciram āvuso ti || || Sāmaṇḍaka-saṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ || || Purimakasadisam eva uddānaṃ || ||  BOOK VI MOGGALĀNA-SAṂYUTTAM
